grouping.parallel: Pair simple_ver and hard_ver rows by domain and source row index, including both rows in one group.
grouping.sequential: Group rows within a domain by SHA-256 of the normalized ordered tool trajectory: tool names, required and optional parameters, execution statuses, and recorded outputs.
grouping.case_id: IDs are derived from source domain and row index; parallel IDs also include simple_ver or hard_ver.

split.tool_count_bucket: The maximum number of tools among group members; exact integer buckets through 10, then 11_plus.
split.quota: Round the global validation group target with floor(n * 0.1 + 0.5). Within each stratum take floor(stratum_size * 0.1), then distribute the remaining quota by descending fractional remainder; ties use SHA-256 of quota:<seed>:<stratum>. The same per-stratum quota is assigned to test and validation.
split.group_order: Within each stratum, sort group IDs by SHA-256 of <seed>:<group_id>. Assign the first quota to test, the next quota to validation, and the remainder to train.
split.warning: Changing the upstream snapshot, normalization code, config, or seed changes the split index. Keep this config and the recorded upstream commit together.
